entities.title: Laumufarþegi browser page
entities.summary: The page players open from the shared link: plain TypeScript with no framework, in Icelandic, made for phones.
entities.purpose: app.ts draws the screen for the view the room sends and sends the player's taps back as actions; index.html, style.css and favicon.svg are the page; _headers sets the static assets' security headers. build.mjs bundles app.ts and copies the rest into dist/games/laumufarthegi/.
boundaries: No rules and no secrets here: the page shows only the view the room sent this player, and the room checks every action again.
Text goes into the page as text, never as HTML (the h() helper).
Keeps only a seat token per room and the last name typed, in localStorage.
